whatItIs: Keeper-reward engine (IKeeperRewards). A roled officer (OFFICER_ROLE) brackets its permissionless poke with beginReward()...payReward(keeper). VGO meters gas itself (transient gasleft snapshots) and mints the keeper 1.25x the base-fee cost of the call in VGC (a separate gas-credit token VGO is the SOLE locked minter of). reward value priced ETH->VGC via a 2-hop SPOT mid-price quote on the PRIVATE DAX (WETH->VY->VGC). VGC per-epoch mint ceiling (in the VGC token) is the emission cap + kill-switch. NO VY pull, NO VCO cap mutation in the new logic (those slots are inert legacy).

Auth/reentrancy/storage sound; engine DORMANT live (vgc=0 -> payReward reverts VgcNotWired).
